capabilities: Organize scenes on kanban boards and a freeform corkboard
Map scenes against plotlines and timelines with transit-map and swimlane views
Manage characters, locations, and custom codex entries with relationship maps
Write the full manuscript in a continuous scrivenings-style view
Export outlines or manuscripts to Markdown, JSON, CSV, HTML, PDF, and DOCX
disambiguation: Not a plotting-only tool; it is a full fiction-writing suite covering brainstorming, drafting, worldbuilding, analysis, and export.
extras: Scrivener import is cautioned as "Results may vary — review imported data carefully"; the Additional Source Folders feature is labeled Experimental; the author requests donations to fund maintenance.
motivation: The author asks for donations to keep the plugin maintained but does not state why it was built.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for planning and drafting long fiction, so writers must assemble boards, templates, and tracking manually.

relations.evidence: Scrivener Import — Import a .scriv project (Scrivener 2 & 3) as a new StoryLine project.

summary: Book planning and writing suite that adds corkboard, kanban scene boards, plotgrids, timelines, character/location codex, stats, and manuscript export to a vault.
